summary: Iter13: Employee profile, bank change approval and celebrations. Backend: 29/29 pass in the new test_employee_profile.py. Covered: GET/PUT /profile/me validation (future date, bad date, UAN with spaces stripped, ESI 10 or 17 digits, empty body returns 400). Avatar: rejects non-image, >3MB and bad base64; PNG upload, then /auth/me avatar_path, then /files fetch, then delete. Bank: validation, lowercase IFSC is uppercased, a new request supersedes the old one, withdraw then 404, profile.bank stays the same while pending. Admin list and decide: sub-admin and employee get 403, bad status 400, approve copies the details with approved_by, 'Already decided' on repeat, reject keeps the old bank with the note, unknown id 404. Admin and sub-admin profile access: sub-admin can only see their team, and gets 403 'This employee is not in your team' for Anita and for admins. PUT ignores bank fields. /celebrations: shape, sort order, no birth year exposed, is_me, 401 when not logged in. Frontend (desktop + 390px mobile): employee /dashboard celebrations card (today birthday and work anniversary, wedding upcoming Mon Oct 26). nav-profile and header-profile-link work. Profile page loads every field. UAN error toast works. Future DOB toast works. Avatar file upload updates the profile and the header immediately. Bank form: holder pre-filled, IFSC uppercased, 'Account numbers don't match' toast, submit shows pending with the current bank unchanged and the edit button hidden, withdraw works, last-decision line shows. Admin Overview celebrations card renders. Admin Team: bank-requests-panel shows New vs Current; reject prompts for a reason and the panel disappears. Approve works and the profile modal then shows the new bank 'Approved by Test Admin'. The modal shows dates, UAN/ESI and the pending change. Sub-admin Team: no bank panel, no Anita row, and the modal shows Ravi's UAN/ESI and bank. All test data was restored (Ravi bank 123456789012/SBIN0001234, original avatar).

minor.issue: PNG uploads are stored with a .jpg path and content-type image/jpeg. The frontend always converts to JPEG, so this only affects direct API clients.
A wedding anniversary is not filtered when years is 0 (a wedding dated today), so the card would show '0 years · wedding anniversary'. Work anniversaries already filter years<1.
The future-date check uses server ddate.today() (UTC), not user_local_today, so an IST user entering today's date just after midnight may get 'can't be in the future'.
Existing behaviour: any logged-in user can fetch any object path. This is fine for avatars, but face and check-in photos are not checked for owner or scope.

ui_bugs.issue: After saving UAN '1001 2345 6789', the server stores the normalised '100123456789'. The input keeps showing the spaced value and the Save button stays enabled (dirty) because local form state is not re-synced from the response.

issues: In the celebrations-today block, the 'TODAY' label runs past the card's right edge because the big Person rows have no right padding or overflow guard.

The same avatar is fetched about 7 times on /dashboard (header plus 3 celebration rows plus re-renders) and check-in photos are fetched twice, so avatars show a grey pulse for 2-5s. Consider caching blob URLs by path.

action_items: Re-sync useSaver form state after a successful save (setF from the response) so normalised UAN/ESI values show and Save becomes disabled
Fix celebrations-today 'TODAY' overflow on mobile (add right padding or wrap)
Optional: skip wedding anniversaries with years 0, use the user's local date for the future-date check, store the correct content-type/extension for PNG avatars, cache AuthPhoto blobs
critical_code_review_comments: EmployeeProfileModal useEffect depends on the inline onClose from TeamTab, so it re-fetches the profile on every TeamTab re-render. Wrap onClose in useCallback or drop it from the deps.
ProfilePage maxDate is computed once at module load, so it goes stale if the tab stays open past midnight.
DELETE /profile/me/avatar only clears users.avatar_path and leaves orphan objects in storage (acceptable, but note it).
server.py is 2750+ lines. Consider splitting the profile/bank/celebrations routes into a separate router module.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; 1 low UI bug, 2 design nits)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. The tests snapshot and restore Ravi's employee_profiles doc and avatar, and delete the bank_change_requests they create. After the UI test, Ravi's bank was restored to 123456789012/SBIN0001234/SBI and the original avatar_path in the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest tests/test_employee_profile.py with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Ravi's dob/joining are on today's month-day (server date is 2026-10-23), wedding is +3 days. Playwright dialog handlers need 'import asyncio' or an async handler passed directly. Admin Team tab: navigate to /admin#team (the click fallback is the first [data-testid*=team]).
